slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A circle is the set of points in a plane at a given distance (the radius) from a given point (the center).

Chord: a segment with both endpoints on the circle. Diameter: a chord through the center (twice the radius). Secant: a line that crosses the circle at two points. Tangent: a line in the plane of the circle that meets it at exactly one point. Arc: a connected piece of the circle. Congruent circles have equal radii. Concentric circles share a center.

slides.title: Check yourself
slides.html: Is every diameter a chord? Is every chord a diameter?
slides.reveal: Every diameter is a chord. A chord is a diameter only if it passes through the center.
